info.title: Tool Call Server
info.description: API for CustomGPT tool calling integration

get.description: List all schemas in the database.

post.description: List the tables in the schema.
List the columns in the table.

Execute SQL query and return the results.
The fields are self-explanatory including the sql_query, aim_of_query, original_user_query, and format.

Search the columns of the tables in a schema where the column name, table name, and schema name match the search criteria.
column_name_ilike is the column name pattern to search for with ILIKE operator including % and _ wildcards. E.g. If you might search for "%comm%" or "%is%" or "is_".

post.summary: When the user initiates a feedback
post.description: Provide feedback including all the important details such as the rating, the feedback, user notes etc.

schema_name.title: Schema Name
schema_name.description: Schema name to fetch name of the tables in it. E.g. dbt_release_intermediate. Leave this empty to check all schemas. This value is compared by a strict equality operator.

table_name.title: Table Name
table_name.description: Table name to fetch information about such as columns, description, etc. E.g. companies. Leave this empty to check all tables. This value is compared by a strict equality operator.

column_name_ilike.title: Column Name Ilike
column_name_ilike.description: Column name pattern to search. E.g. 'is%' that filters the columns that starts with 'is'. This value directly goes into the ILIKE operator.

uuid.title: The assigned UUID
uuid.description: The UUID assigned by the server that will be used for the whole conversation.

tool_counter.title: Next Tool Counter
tool_counter.description: The tool counter that should be used for the next tool call.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result data of the tool call. It can be a string, a number, a boolean, an array, or an object.

query_result_data.title: Query Result Data
query_result_data.description: The result data of the tool call. Each item can be of any type: string, number, boolean, array, or object.

error.title: The error explained in detail
error.description: The error object that contains information about the error in case something went wrong.

message_to_assistant.title: Message for the Assistant
message_to_assistant.description: Message for the assistant to proceed with the next tool call. A list of strings that will be used to guide the assistant.

workarounds_to_recover.title: Possible Workarounds for Error Recovery
workarounds_to_recover.description: A list of possible causes for the error and corresponding guidance to help recover from it.

guidance_to_assistant.title: Guidance for the Assistant
guidance_to_assistant.description: Guidance for the assistant to proceed with the next tool call. A list of strings that will be used to guide the assistant.

message_to_assistant.title: Message for the Assistant
message_to_assistant.description: Message for the assistant to proceed with the next tool call. A list of strings that will be used to guide the assistant.

original_user_query.title: Original User Query
original_user_query.example: Hey there, please get the first 10 users. Thank you!

response_format.title: Response Format
response_format.description: Format of the response e.g. csv or json

schema_name.title: Schema Name
schema_name.description: Schema name to fetch name of the tables in it. E.g. dbt_release_intermediate

schema_name.title: Schema Name
schema_name.description: Schema name to fetch name of the tables in it. E.g. dbt_release_intermediate

table_name.title: Table Name
table_name.description: Table name to fetch information about such as columns, description, etc. E.g. companies

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Rating of the overall performance of the assitant in chat in a scale of 1 to 5. If the user did not provide a rating, you can judge overall chat performance.

issues_encountered.title: Issues Encountered
issues_encountered.description: Issues encountered by the assistant. E.g. it assumed some values which are not present in the data. A few sentences can be used to describe the assistant's mistakes.
issues_encountered.example: As an AI assistant, I incorrectly assumed the value of opportunity_owner_area was lowercase, when it was actually uppercase (e.g., 'APAC'). Additionally, I mistakenly thought '1-3 Seats' was a value for operational_segmentation_as_of_today, but the correct values were 'Small', 'Medium', and 'Enterprise'.

features_that_worked_well.title: Features That Worked Well
features_that_worked_well.description: Features that worked well by the assistant. E.g. it was able to fetch the data from the database. A few sentences can be used to describe the assistant's features.
features_that_worked_well.example: As an AI assistant, the provided context was super helpful and at first trial I generated correct SQL and executed it successfully with no issues.

successful_tool_call_count.title: Successful Tool Call Count
successful_tool_call_count.description: Number of successful tool calls made by the assistant. In case of success, it was able to fetch the data from the database. A single number can be used to describe the assistant's features. E.g. 3

failed_tool_call_count.title: Failed Tool Call Count
failed_tool_call_count.description: Number of failed tool calls made by the assistant. In case of failure, it was not able to fetch the data from the database. A single number can be used to describe the assistant's features. E.g. 2

tool_calls_failed_because_of.title: Tool Calls Failed Because Of
tool_calls_failed_because_of.description: A few sentences can be used to describe the assistant's tool usage failures. E.g. the schema name was wrong. E.g. Tool calls failed because of that the assistant was not able to fetch the data with the time limit.
tool_calls_failed_because_of.example: The tool calls failed because of that the assistant was not aware of the right column values for the type.

suggestions_for_improvement.title: Suggestions to the Developers for Improvement
suggestions_for_improvement.description: Suggestions to the developers for improvement. It's better to clariffy companies_d and companies difference better, as it causes confusion and wrong data is fetched. `companies_d` is a huge table and it's not good for average or summation stats. A few sentences can be used to describe the assistant's features. E.g. the schema name was wrong.
suggestions_for_improvement.example: The schema list includes noisy data so it's better to remove it. For enum values it's better to provide me example values.

general_comments.title: General Comments
general_comments.description: General comments. A few sentences can be used to describe the app performance, user experience, etc. E.g. The app is working quite well but there's room for improvement in table selection process.
general_comments.example: The user left very happy as the response was very helpful and the assistant was able to fetch the data from the database.

additional_comments.title: Additional Comments
additional_comments.description: Additional comments. A few sentences can be used to describe the app performance, user experience, etc. E.g. The app is working quite well but there's room for improvement in table selection process.
additional_comments.example: The user was probably knowing the databse structure very well so they guided me to the right direction.

user.title: User
user.description: The user identity. E.g. Jicky from Sales team, Anonymous SDR, or A Product Manager. Whatever clue you have include it.
user.example: Jicky from Sales team, Anonymous SDR, or A Junior Data Analyst.

uuid.title: Conversation UUID
uuid.description: A unique identifier for this conversation. Use the same UUID for all related requests. For a new conversation, set this to 'please-generate-a-uuid'.

tool_counter.title: Conversation Tool Counter
tool_counter.description: A number to indicate the which tool call is this in this conversation. Start from 1 and always increment by 1.
